approved: Explained the Governor-General Amendment (Salary) Bill setting the incoming Governor-General's salary at $425,000 a year, tracing the office's salary history from the original 10,000 pounds set in 1901, and noting the figure accounts for General Cosgrove's military pension, following the precedent set by Sir William Deane.

Summed up debate on the Governor-General Amendment (Salary) Bill, confirming the incoming Governor-General's salary of $425,000 a year, noting the appointment was announced on 28 January 2014 and reflects General Cosgrove's request that his military pension be deducted, following precedents set by Sir William Deane and Quentin Bryce.
